messages:
incident-bot: [11:03 PT] ALERT: p99 latency spike detected for streaming endpoints (us-west-2). SLO at risk. p95 baselined 120ms -> 450ms; p99 600ms -> 2400ms. Affected: prefix-cache + paging. Rule: streaming-tail-latency. Auto-notify oncall alex.k. Link: https://redwood.status/incident/4321 :fire:

alex.k: I'm on it. Observing increased tail latency and streaming stalls. Any recent rollouts? I see a prefix-hash rollout completed ~10:45 PT.

maya: confirmed — we rolled prefix-hash v3 to 40% traffic at 10:40 PT, target was 100% tonight. Metrics show prefix_hit_rate dropping.

cj: can you paste the hot metrics? I pulled from dashboards: 
```
prefix_hit_rate: baseline 92.1% -> 34.7%
page_evictions_per_min: +420%
kv_fetch_latency_p99: 12ms -> 980ms
streaming_tail_p99: 2.4s
affected_shards: shard-12, shard-13, shard-18
```

alex.k: Customer impact — support flags show increased streaming stalls for ~1.2% of sessions; a few high-volume tenants seeing partial responses. Ticket INC-4321 opened: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-4321

taylor: Support: two paying customers reported truncated streaming outputs, one escalated to SE. Not widespread but p99 breach triggers SLA concerns.

sri: Early mitigation attempt: warming prefix cache for hot prefixes, but warmup isn't hitting because salted prefix variant doesn't match old keys.

maya: That aligns. v3 introduced salted namespace to reduce collisions; we didn't coordinate eviction/key-migration with prefix cache. Hit rate collapse expected.

cj: Options: 1) Rollback prefix-hash v3 (fast but requires traffic shift), 2) Add compatibility layer that maps v3->v2 salted prefixes (complex), 3) Increase fallback TTL/serve stale while background rebuilds.

alex.k: For immediate SLO safety, prefer rollback. Can we execute canary rollback to 0% within ~10m?

maya: We can push rollback; will need to update routing policy and restart a small set of edge proxies (no model restarts). ETA ~8m.

incident-bot: ACTION: Oncall handoff to next (cj) scheduled at 12:00 PT. Current oncall: alex.k. Please include rollback confirmation in handoff notes.

cj: I'll take over after rollback. alex, run the rollout rollback and mark it `prefix-hash-v3: rollback-initiated` in rollout service.

alex.k: Executing rollback now.

[~2 minutes later]

alex.k: rollback command:
```
rolloutctl rollback prefix-hash-v3 --target 0 --reason "live p99 spike"
```

alex.k: rolloutctl reports 0% in ~6m. Monitoring...

maya: dashboards updating: prefix_hit_rate climbing back: 34.7 -> 65% -> 88% within 7m.

sri: kv_fetch_latency_p99 improving: 980ms -> 60ms. streaming_tail_p99 -> 280ms. p95 back near baseline.

taylor: Support: customer's truncated streams reduced. SE updated customer. No further escalations so far.

cj: Good. Leaving a mitigation note: we need pre-rollback checklist in rollout docs to include compatibility warming and crosscheck for salted key migrations.

alex.k: Handoff to cj now. Key points: rollback done; partial customer impact (INC-4321) handled; watch for re-rollout readiness; open follow-up epic for migration strategy.

cj: Acknowledged. I'll run extended monitoring for 2 hours and capture traces for affected shards. Will coordinate postmortem.

incident-bot: INCIDENT update: status -> mitigated (rollback applied). Postmortem requested. Triage meeting scheduled in #incidents at 16:00 PT. 

maya: Initial root cause summary: premature prefix-hash-v3 rollout without warm key migration caused salt mismatch -> cache miss storm -> backend paging + kv pressure -> streaming tail degradation. 

sri: Action items assigned:
- eng-runtime: add rollout safety for prefix hashing + prewarm (maya)
- eng-sre: add alert for prefix_hit_rate delta >20% (cj)
- product: coordinate rollout windows and customer impact comms (taylor)

alex.k: Any objections to labeling this Sev-2? If SLA risk and customer escalations happened, seems appropriate.

cj: Agreed Sev-2.

taylor: I'll draft customer communication and send to affected accounts.

alex.k: Handoff notes: monitoring queries, log snippets, rollback command in thread. I'm out of rotation in 30m.

cj: Thanks — I'll own the postmortem. Please add any extra traces to the ticket INC-4321.

incident-bot: Thread closed for now — reopen if symptoms reappear. :white_check_mark:
